name: panel_01_setup
prompt:
A 4-panel Korean comic strip, panel 1 of 4. Pixar-style flat children-book illustration, clean bold black outlines, warm pastel colors (cream, peach, soft teal), simple comic panel composition with a thin black border. Two consistent recurring human characters appear throughout this comic and must be drawn IDENTICALLY in every panel:

Character A — a 30-year-old Korean male office worker (export-industry employee). Neat short black hair parted to the side, clean white dress shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbow, navy slacks, slim build, average height. Always holds a smartphone in his right hand. Expressive cartoon face, large round eyes, simple nose.

Character B — a 40-year-old Korean female café owner. Short bobbed brown hair, beige apron over a light blue t-shirt, rolled receipt in her left hand and a small calculator on the counter in front of her, slightly tired posture. Expressive cartoon face, large round eyes, simple nose.

Scene for THIS panel (panel 1, setup): Interior of a small cozy Korean café. Character B stands behind the wooden counter, looking down at a small paper receipt in her hand. Coffee machine and mugs visible in the background. Her shoulders slump, eyebrows pulled together, mouth in a clear downturned sigh — sad and weary expression. Soft warm light from a ceiling lamp. From her mouth, a white speech bubble with a tail points to her: inside the bubble in clear Korean, the text reads "수입 원가가...". The bubble is rounded with a black outline. Camera: medium shot, eye level, focused on Character B at the counter. Character A is NOT in this panel. ONGLE mascot is NOT in this panel. No other text anywhere — only the speech bubble Korean text.

name: panel_03_twist
prompt:
A 4-panel Korean comic strip, panel 3 of 4. Pixar-style flat children-book illustration, clean bold black outlines, warm pastel colors (cream, peach, soft teal), simple comic panel composition with a thin black border. The same two consistent recurring human characters from panels 1 and 2, plus the ONGLE mascot — all drawn IDENTICALLY to their established appearance:

Character A — a 30-year-old Korean male office worker. Neat short black hair parted to the side, white dress shirt with rolled sleeves, navy slacks, slim build. Holds a smartphone. He is now seated on the LEFT side of the panel at the café table, looking up curiously.

Character B — a 40-year-old Korean female café owner. Short bobbed brown hair, beige apron over a light blue t-shirt, holds a receipt. She stands on the RIGHT side of the panel behind the counter, looking up curiously.

ONGLE — a small round eyeball mascot. The body is a thick bright-orange ring (like a donut) about the size of a tennis ball. Inside the ring, a single large eye fills the center — white sclera, vivid blue iris with a small white highlight, black pupil. Two tiny rounded brown feet stick out at the bottom. No mouth, no hands. Flat children-book style with bold outlines.

Scene for THIS panel (panel 3, twist): Wide shot of the café interior. ONGLE floats gently in the air between Character A (left) and Character B (right), centered, slightly above their heads. Both characters tilt their heads up and look at ONGLE with surprised, curious expressions — eyebrows raised, mouths slightly open. ONGLE's single pupil is centered, calm and watchful. A white rounded speech bubble with a tail points to ONGLE: inside the bubble in clear Korean, the text reads "같은 22.9원이에요". The bubble has a black outline. Soft cream background, café details (counter, table) faintly visible. Camera: medium wide shot, eye level, balanced composition. No other text anywhere — only the speech bubble Korean text.

name: panel_04_punchline
prompt:
A 4-panel Korean comic strip, panel 4 of 4 — the punchline panel. Pixar-style flat children-book illustration, clean bold black outlines, warm pastel colors (cream, peach, soft teal), simple comic panel composition with a thin black border. The same two consistent recurring human characters — drawn IDENTICALLY to panels 1-3:

Character A — a 30-year-old Korean male office worker. Neat short black hair parted to the side, white dress shirt with rolled sleeves, navy slacks, slim build. Holds a smartphone.

Character B — a 40-year-old Korean female café owner. Short bobbed brown hair, beige apron over a light blue t-shirt, holds a receipt.

Scene for THIS panel (panel 4, punchline): Both characters are shown side by side from the chest up, facing the viewer in close-up, on a soft pastel background split vertically — Character A on the left half with a warm peach/cream tint, Character B on the right half with a soft teal/blue tint. Both characters look at the SAME small floating chart graphic between them in the middle foreground. The chart is a tiny simple downward-sloping line graph with one clear bold number label that reads exactly "1,512.1" (no other text on the chart). Character A is smiling broadly with bright happy eyes. Character B is sighing with sad downturned mouth and tired eyes. They see the SAME data; their faces are opposite. NO speech bubbles in this panel. NO other text anywhere on the panel except the number "1,512.1" on the chart. Camera: medium close-up, eye level, symmetric two-shot composition. The punchline is told by their opposite expressions reacting to the same number. ONGLE mascot is NOT in this panel.
